name: Dispute Resolution Time
summary: Average dispute cycle time is 15 days vs a 12-day target. Most of the time is lost in manual evidence gathering and approval wait — exactly where the Evidence Assembly and Outcome agents compress the cycle.

drivers.name: Evidence assembly time
drivers.narrative: Manual evidence gathering across ERP, logistics and contracts is the single biggest delay.
drivers.rootCause: Handlers manually search 4–6 systems per case; the Evidence Assembly agent reduces this from hours to minutes via RAG retrieval.

drivers.name: Cycle time by dispute type
drivers.narrative: Some dispute types age far longer than others.
drivers.rootCause: Install-milestone and quality disputes require field-service input, extending cycle time; upstream alerts cut their recurrence.

drivers.name: SLA status
drivers.narrative: Share of cases on-track vs at-risk vs breached.
drivers.rootCause: Breaches cluster where evidence is hard to assemble and approval queues back up; the SLA monitor escalates before deadlines slip.
